summary: INSIDE entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

primary.why: INSIDE is a tightly authored single-player game with no known platform-exclusive story content. The PC release is the best capture/settings route, while console/mobile ports are useful access paths.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release. Record storefront/build, resolution, frame-rate/VSync state, controller, gamma/display, audio setup, collectible/secret ending state, and whether console/mobile versions were compared.

secondary.platform: Xbox One / PlayStation / Nintendo Switch / iOS / Apple TV / macOS
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting platform behavior or portability.
secondary.why: PC is the best capture route and no sourced exclusive content requires another route.
